notes: «وَ رُوِيَ» is a passive verb with no transmitter named, so it is not a link; «عن معاوية بن وهب» gives the first link; «قال: قلت لأبي عبد الله» places the Imam in the words after the chain, so he is the last link as imam_in_text; «عليه السلام» is a blessing; «ذكر لنا» and «رجل من الأنصار» are inside the saying's story, not links
